decision_conditions: <p>The proposed basement extension, by reason of its substantial size, detailed design, and level of excavation, results in the loss of vegetation at the site and fails to provide a minimum of 1m of suitable soil to restore effective ground infiltration, facilitate planting, and support local biodiversity by way of replacement. As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies G1 (Green infrastructure) and G6 (Biodiversity and access to nature) of the London Plan (2021), policies LP46 (Protection and Enhancement of Green Infrastructure) and LP47 (<span style="background-color: transparent; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Biodiversity and Sites of Importance of Nature Conservation)</span>&nbsp;of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).&nbsp;</p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-034b7b70-7fff-2a6c-4d5d-be73c18f111d"></span><br></p>

<span id="docs-internal-guid-a212fcb4-7fff-4c37-cec4-39ddb8f36969"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed basement extension and rear lightwell, by reason of their size, depth and detailed design, results in a disproportionate development that involves the loss of over 50% of the rear garden, extending 7m past the existing rear wall of the dwelling to the full width of the property being set against the boundary with both adjoining neighbours. This has a harmful impact on the character and appearance of the host property and the terrace it forms part of.&nbsp; As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach) and D4 (Delivering good design) of the London Plan (2021), policies LP1 (Design Quality of Local Character) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).</span></p></span>
